Hon'ble Syed Aftab Husain Rizvi,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri Binod Kumar Jha, learned counsel for the informant and learned A.G.A. appearing for the State.

This petition has been filed with the prayer to quash the First Information Report registered as Case Crime No.0336 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 452, 323 and 506 IPC, Police Station-Rorawar, District-Aligarh.

While entertaining this writ petition, this Court has referred the matter to the Mediation Centre,
requiring it to submit a report.

Report has been received from Mediation Centre, as per which, the parties have resolved their differences and a notarial affidavit, containing the terms of such Javed @ Banti And 2 Others vs The State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9722060/
1 settlement, has also been submitted before the Investigating Officer.
Learned counsel representing the parties also made statement that the parties have resolved their differences amicably and no dispute survives in the matter.

Consequently, the F.I.R. in Case Crime No.0336 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 452, 323 and 506 IPC, Police Station-Rorawar, District-Aligarh stands quashed.
